paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.13, representing a 4.3% decrease from the prior close. Over a window of 22 sessions, the stock has seen a 1.24% increase.
There is one new news item in the last 24 hours, with Seeking Alpha reporting that Fermi received a subpoena from a US District Court for documents related to the Project Matador data center campus.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer. There is also one Form 4 filing in the feed.
